title: terraform: private deployment state layout + GPU node pools, IAM, networking
author: Priya Natarajan
body: Motivation: private deployments regularly hit state/layout drift when we add GPU node pools and additional IAM roles across multiple TF workspaces. This PR standardizes the remote state layout, splits stateful resources into stable modules, and adds a new gpu-node-pool module with opinionated defaults for on-prem and cloud private installs. What this changes: 1) remote state re-org: move per-cluster state into workspace-per-environment layout and add locking configuration and clearer backend naming to avoid accidental cross-environment applies; 2) new modules/gpu-node-pool: parameterized node pool sizing, GPU type mappings, taints/labels and a small init DaemonSet hook to pre-pull model artifacts for faster first-run latency; 3) IAM module updates: separate service account roles for control-plane vs inference nodes, least-privilege role bindings, and optional KMS/HSM integration flags for secrets; 4) networking: updated VPC subnets layout to allow isolated control plane subnets and explicit nat/eip allocation for customer air-gapped setups; 5) migration helpers: include terraform plan-only migration steps and a script to create transitional state copies for customers running private upgrades. Compatibility and rollout: this PR is backwards-compatible for new installs. Existing installs require a documented migration path included in upgrade_notes.md and the included migration helper script. Testing: added terratest-based unit tests for module inputs and added a smoke test against a small k8s cluster in our test lab. See changed files for details. This description includes the checklist used before merging: - [x] Module unit tests added and passing - [x] Migration doc written and reviewed - [x] Security review completed for IAM changes - [x] CI green with integration smoke test - [x] Confirmed with infra and SRE on rollback plan
commits: c1f4b3a: initial layout refactor + backend naming conventions
d2e7f92: add modules/gpu-node-pool with GPU type map and taints
e3b9a11: split iam roles into control_plane and inference_node service accounts
f4a2c45: vpc subnet changes + optional nat/eip allocation flags
a5d6b78: add migration helper script, upgrade_notes.md and terratest cases
release_notes: Stabilize private deployment TF state layout and add a GPU node pool module. Includes migration helpers and documented upgrade path. No runtime breaking changes for new installs; existing customers must follow upgrade_notes.md for state migration.
discussion: Mark Chen (reviewer): The state re-org looks sensible but I want to double-check the backend naming pattern to ensure we don't accidentally point two workspaces to the same backend key. Can we add explicit workspace locks and documented examples?

Priya Natarajan (author): Added workspace lock examples and clarified backend key naming in state/backend.tf and upgrade_notes.md. The migration script creates a temporary lock and validates key uniqueness before copying.
Sofia Martinez (reviewer): IAM changes look good. Please confirm the least-privilege roles have been audited by security. I saw use of kms_integration flag; what's the default?

Priya Natarajan (author): Security reviewed roles, approval attached. Default for kms_integration is false; documented in modules/iam/variables.tf and upgrade_notes.md. Customers can opt-in during install.

Dmitri Ivanov (sre): Deployed smoke in staging lab. Observed a small regression in create time due to image pulls on GPU nodes; author added a DaemonSet pre-pull hook. Recommend monitoring first-10-min pod readiness as part of rollout.
Mark Chen (reviewer): CI flaked once on terratest networking; reran and green. Approving pending squash commit message tidy-up.
Sofia Martinez (reviewer): Security approval granted. Approved.
Evan Chambers (owner): Merged via squash after checks passed.
